item.title: Scottish Government Sets Out Next Steps to Tackle Child Sexual Abuse
item.description: The Scottish Government has set out urgent next steps to tackle child sexual abuse, including immediate action from a national review, new funding for victim support, and work towards mandatory reporting, with ministers pledging that survivors’ voices will be central to future decisions.The post Scottish Government Sets Out Next Steps to Tackle Child Sexual Abuse appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Over 837,000 Winter Heating Payments Made Across Scotland
item.description: More than 837,000 winter heating payments have already been made across Scotland, with unique support for families, people on low incomes and pensioners aimed at easing fuel poverty and helping households cope with rising energy costs during the coldest months.The post Over 837,000 Winter Heating Payments Made Across Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Loch Garten Reserve Marks 50 Years With New Land Purchase
item.description: A landmark land purchase has been completed at Loch Garten as RSPB Scotland marks 50 years of protecting one of the Highlands’ most important nature reserves, expanding grazing to restore Caledonian woodland and support species such as Capercaillie and Ospreys.The post Loch Garten Reserve Marks 50 Years With New Land Purchase appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Outdoor Learning Bill Wins Backing as Highland Candidate Points to Lifelong Impact
item.description: Outdoor education can make a huge difference to children’s lives, says SNP candidate Eilidh Munro, after Holyrood passed new legislation requiring councils to ensure access to residential outdoor learning, with supporters highlighting benefits for young people and Highland communities.The post Outdoor Learning Bill Wins Backing as Highland Candidate Points to Lifelong Impact appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ducati Unveils 2026 Apparel Collection Blending Performance, Heritage and Everyday Style
item.description: Ducati has unveiled its 2026 Apparel Collection, introducing new Corse, Touring and Urban gear alongside The Origin Collection, blending racing performance, everyday comfort and heritage inspired design for riders who live the Ducati lifestyle on and off the bike.The post Ducati Unveils 2026 Apparel Collection Blending Performance, Heritage and Everyday Style appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Warns Festive Discounts Risk Undermining Scottish Growers
item.description: NFU Scotland has warned supermarkets that excessive festive discounting on fresh produce risks undermining Scottish growers, calling for fairer pricing, reduced reliance on imports, and stronger protections to support domestic horticulture and long term food security.The post NFU Scotland Warns Festive Discounts Risk Undermining Scottish Growers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Urges Festive Recycling as Bin Dates Change Across The Region
item.description: Highland Council is urging residents to cut waste and recycle properly over Christmas, with reminders about the twin bin system, soft plastic limits, electrical reuse containers, and changed bin collection dates across the Highlands during the festive period.The post Highland Council Urges Festive Recycling as Bin Dates Change Across The Region appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Corran Ferry Foot Passenger Services Continue After Vessel Fault
item.description: Foot passenger services are continuing on the Corran Ferry route after a steering fault forced the withdrawal of the relief vessel, with Highland Council providing alternative crossings and working to restore full service while repairs and refits are completed.The post Corran Ferry Foot Passenger Services Continue After Vessel Fault appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow Set to Return to Inverness in 2026
item.description: The Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow is set to return to Inverness in February 2026, bringing riders, police, fire service and safety experts together for a free evening focused on safer riding, real world collisions and practical skills for Highland motorcyclists.The post Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow Set to Return to Inverness in 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Welcomes Cherry Blossom Gift From Japan Ahead of Christmas
item.description: Orkney has become the UK’s most northerly recipient of Sakura cherry blossom trees through a Japan UK friendship project, with 30 trees being planted across schools and communities and locals invited to share photos ahead of a spring celebration.The post Orkney Welcomes Cherry Blossom Gift From Japan Ahead of Christmas appeared first on The Highland Times.
